topic.source_contract: groundwater source protection zones, safeguard zones, vulnerability, permitting and monitoring

scope_guards: An SPZ map hit is not treated as refusal, permission or confirmed contamination.
SPZ, safeguard-zone and groundwater-vulnerability layers are not conflated.
Area-level mapping is not treated as exact parcel or abstraction-source binding.
Planning permission is not treated as an environmental permit.
A permit application is not treated as a granted or operational permit.
Proposed mitigation is not treated as installed and monitored mitigation.
Absence from a mapped zone is not treated as absence of groundwater risk.
No score or promotion is written without exact overlay, pathway, permission, mitigation and monitoring evidence.
